items.title: 消除 10 个 high uncovered_requirement
items.context: 逐条核对 gap_analyze 输出：若已有实现则补/调整 @task 注释覆盖对应 truth 关键词；若缺实现则补最小实现；若是愿景/建议而非当前 requirement，则调整真相源分类或覆盖策略。
items.userSees: 终端输出包含 "high: 0"，且不再出现 "10 个高优先级差距" / "10 high-priority gaps"。

happy.desc: 运行 gap_analyze 时，10 个 high uncovered_requirement 都能映射到真实实现或明确的覆盖说明，high gap 数为 0。
每个新增/调整的 @task 都落在对应实现模块，而不是集中到虚假 coverage 文件里。

edge.desc: 若某个 requirement 只是愿景或历史建议而无实现，gap_analyze 不能被注释硬盖过去。

adversarial.desc: 不能通过降低 gap severity、删 truth、或关闭 analyzer 来让 high gap 消失。

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke asserts high gap count is 0 and coveragePercent is 100; local run printed 差距: 0 high / 32 medium.

verificationEvidence.command: git show HEAD -- packages/main/src/core/health.ts packages/main/src/core/anti-stall.ts packages/main/src/core/phase-flow.ts packages/main/src/core/workflow-policy.ts packages/main/src/handlers/story-review.ts packages/main/src/handlers/reviewer-list.ts packages/main/src/core/process-metrics.ts
verificationEvidence.note: Reviewed @task mappings are placed in the relevant implementation modules for health classification, anti-stall retry/fix/discard, phase graph health, workflow policy, reviewer policy, process metrics, and story review rather than in a fake coverage-only file.

Analyzer rules still scan truth requirements and produce gaps; the change merges source @task annotations with metadata-backed annotations and does not delete truth, lower severity, or skip uncovered requirements.
Diff does not edit truth docs or lower severity thresholds; high gaps disappear because code annotations now cover requirements and gap smoke verifies analyzer output.

items.title: 将需求覆盖率提升到 100% 或解释剩余非需求项
items.context: 重新运行 gap_analyze/convergence_check，确保 high gap 为 0 且 coverage 不再因已覆盖需求停在 88%。
items.userSees: 终端输出包含 "需求覆盖率: 100%" 或 "requirements coverage: 100%"，并且 high uncovered requirement 数量为 0。

happy.desc: 运行 convergence_check 时，需求覆盖率输出为 100%，高优先级差距为 0。
若 medium no_test gap 仍存在，输出能清楚说明它们不是本次 10 个 high uncovered_requirement。

edge.desc: coverage smoke 测试在没有工作区外部状态依赖时可重复运行。

adversarial.desc: 不能把 coverage 分母改小或跳过 truth 文件来得到 100%。

verificationEvidence.command: npm run test:gap-coverage-smoke && node packages/main/dist/cli.js convergence_check
verificationEvidence.note: gap coverage smoke passed with coveragePercent 100 and highGaps length 0; convergence_check shows 无高优先级差距 passed and 需求覆盖率 detail 100%.
gap_analyze now reports 差距: 0 high / 32 medium, making remaining medium no_test gaps explicit and separate from high uncovered requirement blockers.
Smoke locates project root from cwd/import path and repeatedly calls analyzeGap without external mutable state; local rerun passed.
No truth files are modified and coverage denominator is still based on scanTruth; the analyzer change broadens code annotation inputs rather than shrinking requirements.

items.title: 兼容旧 verificationIntent type alias
items.context: 当前 schema 只接受 logic/cli/browser/manual/docs；旧文档/agent 可能写 cli_blackbox/browser_blackbox。必须在 CLI 输入解析层自动归一：cli_blackbox -> cli、browser_blackbox -> browser，并补回归测试证明旧 payload 可以通过 checklist_update/story_create/checklist_add 等入口。不能只提示用户手动迁移。
items.userSees: 旧 payload 不再输出 "Invalid enum value"；smoke 测试输出 "verificationIntent alias smoke passed"。

happy.desc: story_create payload 中 verificationIntent.type=cli_blackbox 会通过 schema parse，并归一为 cli。
checklist_add payload 中 verificationIntent.type=browser_blackbox 会通过 schema parse，并归一为 browser。
checklist_update payload 中 cli_blackbox/browser_blackbox 都会通过 schema parse，并保存为 cli/browser。

edge.desc: 当前有效值 logic/cli/browser/manual/docs 行为保持不变。

adversarial.desc: 非法 type 仍然被拒绝，不能因为兼容 alias 而接受任意字符串。

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke parses story_create with type=cli_blackbox and asserts normalized output type is cli.
Smoke parses checklist_add with type=browser_blackbox and asserts normalized output type is browser.
Smoke parses checklist_update with cli_blackbox and browser_blackbox and asserts they normalize to cli/browser.
Smoke loops through current valid values logic/cli/browser/manual/docs and asserts they remain unchanged after parsing.
Smoke uses a complete story_create payload with type=not_a_real_type and asserts schema parsing fails, proving alias compatibility does not accept arbitrary strings.
